items.quote: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
items.claim: Moses refuses to sacrifice the Egyptians' abominations before their eyes, because the Egyptians would stone them

items.quote: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.
items.claim: Moses proposes that the Israelites will journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to God according to God's command
items.place: three days' journey into the wilderness
